concepts.definition: The workspace and its authoritative inputs persist across activations. Their current material state is the continuing truth surface deciding what work has and has not occurred; work state and closed results carry continuity without requiring another carrier.

grounding.quote:
The workspace and its authoritative inputs persist across activations and
are the continuing truth surface of the work: the surface whose current
material state decides what the work has and has not done.

concepts.label: Workspace truth surface

concepts.definition: An actor's context is a bounded projection and revisable account of work state, disposable because required step-produced facts and closed results are recorded before return. It is never a second truth surface; later intake reconstructs governing relations without needing the previous actor's context.

grounding.quote:
An account is
never a second truth surface, and no later activation needs a prior
actor's context: its intake reconstructs the governing relations without
it (§1 Intake) (P0, P3, P6).

concepts.label: Actor's account

concepts.definition: Proportionality relates semantic ambiguity removed to effective reasoning complexity introduced. Complexity includes independent concepts and authority surfaces, joins, exceptions, branching, states, transitions, duplicated representations needing reconciliation and decision-relevant detail; it is not raw line, artifact or context-window size. Cost is selected when it is the governed question.

grounding.quote:
Proportionality is the relation between semantic ambiguity removed and
effective reasoning complexity introduced. A method obligation is
proportional when its contraction of the admissible interpretation space
justifies the additional concepts, relations, projections and evidence an
actor must hold together to reach a correct decision

concepts.label: Proportionality and selected cost

concepts.definition: A resource limit bounds activation consumption of context, attention, wall time, spend, human effort, communication or machine resources. This subsection owns the generic declaration, measurement and exhaustion law, but sets no limit value; selected execution bindings supply values and measurable units and boundaries.

grounding.quote:
A resource limit bounds a resource that an activation consumes: context,
attention, wall time, spend, human effort, communication or a machine
resource (P0). This subsection owns the law for every such limit. It sets
no value (P0, P2, P5, P6):

concepts.label: Declared resource limit

concepts.definition: A closed result identifies frame, activation, subject, basis, evaluation, actor, evidence, verdict, residual uncertainty and invalidation conditions. It supports handoff and exact-applicability reuse without requiring private working context. Its affectedness is expressed by dependencies D*(t) meeting change impact cover I(Δ).

grounding.quote:
A closed result identifies the frame and its activation, the subject, the
basis, the evaluation, the actor, the evidence, the verdict, the residual
uncertainty and the invalidation conditions

concepts.label: Closed result and reuse

concepts.definition: Transition evidence is a consumer-represented read model of an exact candidate, affected relations, changed realisation paths, added or removed authority paths, retained and open seams, focused and required integration proofs, explicit non-changes, any activated assessor's recommended disposition and the decision owner's disposition once made.

grounding.quote:
Consumers
choose the representation. Transition evidence is a read
model; it does not become specification, design or admission authority

concepts.label: Transition evidence

concepts.definition: The source-disposition register records claimed conservation, new successor rules, ownership routes, generalisations, exceptions and pending replacements relative to rc.2. Its foundation-to-law tables distinguish derived consequences from owned policy choices and decide nothing. Register statements are provenance and proposal data, not this interpretation's acceptance of equivalence or supersession.

grounding.quote: a table decides nothing and names the rule that states each consequence.

concepts.label: Activation source-disposition register

concepts.definition: ASSURANCE is a tier-2 owner of verification layers, testing taxonomy and two proof authorities, fixture portability, test authority, scenarios, installed proof, significant paths, testing frames, combinatorial value, legitimate-path erasure, evidence composition, subject acquisition, localisation and interface integration. It consumes tier-1 laws without redefining them. SPEC_METHOD owns the particular chain/change classes; PRODUCT_DEFINITION owns project bindings. Design-module and ticket test authority are not pre-empted. EXECUTIVE_BASELINE maps roles at tier 3 and is not a dependency. Predecessor routes are provenance only; the standalone successor claims to restate received rows fully.

grounding.quote:
[EVALUATION](EVALUATION.md) (claims, separation, independent
assessment, acceptance, conformance) and [ACTIVATION](ACTIVATION.md)
(§1 applicability and the execution relation, §6 proportionality, §7
reuse); adds no definition to tier 1.

concepts.label: ASSURANCE member

concepts.definition: Requirements preserve invariant truth and ask what must be true; design preserves structural choice and asks how that truth is realised; scenarios preserve operational meaning and ask whether the realised system can do the claimed thing. Scenarios are the product-owner layer of concrete end-to-end use cases from intent to realised behaviour.

grounding.quote:
| Requirements | invariant truth | what must be true? |
| Design | structural choice | how is that truth realised? |
| Scenarios | operational meaning | can the realised system actually do the claimed thing? |

concepts.label: Verification layers

concepts.definition: F14 organises evidence for claims about realised products. Its instance premises, not supplied by commitments, are a runnable/observable product in source and runnable forms; composition across modules, interfaces and owners; user outcomes on supported surfaces; possible external worker/transport/fixture boundaries; and optionally design-governed module boundaries. The table accounts for §§1–16; §17 records dispositions and decides nothing. It distinguishes consequences, domain/policy choices and their owners.

grounding.quote:
decides what evidence proves a claim about a realised product and how
that evidence is organised. Its instance premises, which the commitments
do not supply, are named in the rows as follows: runnable product, a
product's realisation can be executed or observed, in a source form and in
a deployed, installed or otherwise runnable form, to produce evidence;

concepts.label: F14 foundation-to-law family

concepts.definition: The Product-level test-authority taxonomy belongs to urn:stdo:bounded-context:product-assurance under the selected complete basis. Its two primary authorities are design/module conformance, derived from realisation authority, and UAT/acceptance, derived from constitutional user/Product authority. Unit denotes conformance scope; integration denotes breadth; sandbox denotes composed-product acceptance execution; harnessed/fake/recorded/deterministic denote non-live execution; live denotes real external worker or transport execution. Shared context does not merge DESIGN_MODULE's module-derived unit-proof authority.

grounding.quote:
Authority source is not execution breadth. A test may be small or broad,
fast or slow, deterministic or live, and still derives from one of two
primary authorities (P6, P1):

1. design or module conformance tests; and
2. UAT, or acceptance, tests.

concepts.label: Testing authority taxonomy

concepts.definition: Fixture and proof portability makes required closure lanes reproducible from their declared source boundary and distinguishes missing-fixture diagnostics from product semantic failure.

grounding.quote:
Required closure lanes are reproducible from the declared source boundary
(P3, P6; rc.2 #fixture-and-proof-portability-rule). A unit, semantic or
module-design conformance lane does not depend on an undeclared local path,
a sibling workspace, an operator home directory or a mutable external
fixture.

concepts.label: Fixture and proof portability

concepts.definition: Written, traceable test-case authority for every live requirement includes appropriate scenario bundles, ordered sequences, negative/control or other explicit evidence cases. Each expected result's assertion provenance identifies its owning obligation, interpretation, assumptions, derivation, shared dependencies, and whether its predicate is the obligation, a necessary condition or part of a sufficient conjunction.

grounding.quote:
Written authority includes the assertion
provenance of each expected result: the owning obligation, its
interpretation, assumptions, derivation and shared dependencies, and
whether the asserted predicate is the obligation, a necessary condition of
it or part of a sufficient conjunction

concepts.label: Written test-case authority

concepts.definition: A scenario bundle exposes the feature/use-case boundary, ordered test-case sequence and expected outcomes at significant steps, making operational meaning inspectable. Declared scenarios pressure intent and design to identify operational boundaries, sequences, actors, controls and outcomes; the source calls them the best source for significant code/control paths.

grounding.quote:
A scenario bundle shows the feature or use-case boundary being exercised,
the test-case sequence that proves it, and the outcomes expected at each
significant step. It is the layer that makes operational meaning
inspectable (P6).

concepts.label: Scenario bundle

conditions: The system has an installable or runnable development form.
concepts.definition: Installed development proof is the decisive proving lane against an installed development version treated as an independent project or externalised target.

grounding.quote:
Where a system has an installable or runnable development form, the
decisive proving lane runs against an installed development version as if
it were an independent project or an externalised target, not only against
the source tree in place

concepts.label: Installed development proof

concepts.definition: Significant-path coverage intentionally declares and proves meaningful paths for the claimed behaviour, rather than every branch in every file. Usual relevant paths are intended success; fail-closed/rejection; boundary/control; integration/dispatch/transport; recovery/retry/replay.

grounding.quote:
The proving surface declares and exercises the significant paths for the
behaviour being claimed (P6, P2; rc.2 #significant-path-coverage-rule).
Exhaustive proof does not mean every possible branch in every file; it
means the project names the meaningful paths and proves them
intentionally. The significant paths usually include, where relevant:

concepts.label: Significant-path coverage

conditions: The governing frame configuration or admitted work authority selects testing frames for a Product promotion, closure or release-assurance claim.
concepts.definition: The Product testing frame set is a claim-relative configuration ordinarily containing user-acceptance, end-to-end, integration and unit frames. Its document placement makes the set and §§8–13 available without adoption or automatic activation. Claim, subject, path, population, oracle and falsification boundary select a frame, not its runner.

grounding.quote: ## 7. Product testing frame set

Placement in this member makes the
set, and the law of §8 to §13 that serves it, available; it adopts nothing,
and each activation is decided by ACTIVATION §1 (Applicability). The kind
of runner does not select the frame; the evaluated claim, subject, path,
population, oracle and falsification boundary do

concepts.label: Product testing frame set

concepts.definition: A testing frame executes or observes a declared subject to discriminate one exact claim using an explicit oracle, evidence population, path boundary and falsification condition. Mere files, suites, runners, fixtures, labels, coverage percentages or actors are not thereby frames; counts, coverage, duration and framework category do not widen the actually exercised claim's authority.

grounding.quote:
A testing frame is a frame (REFERENCE_FRAME §1) whose evaluation executes
or observes a declared subject to discriminate one exact claim through an
explicit oracle, evidence population, path boundary and falsification
condition.

concepts.label: Testing frame

concepts.definition: An authoritative Product path is the declared ordinary causal composition from supported user/public entry through exact selected interfaces, owners, state transitions, effects, persistence and recovery to the required outcome projection. Expected output through bypasses, obsolete executors, test-only seams, undeclared fallbacks or competing authority falsifies path conformance even when output values match.

grounding.quote:
Producing an expected output through a bypass, an obsolete executor, a
test-only seam, an undeclared fallback or a competing authority falsifies
path conformance even when the output value is equal

concepts.label: Authoritative Product path

concepts.definition: Material combinatorial complexity is the claim-relative population of independent dimensions/interactions whose combinations can change outcomes, violate invariants, select authority paths or expose failures. Unit scope includes module-owned public-contract laws, operators, calculation regimes, states, transitions, boundary classes and failures. Cross-participant interface, Product, persistence, configuration and user-role combinations belong to integration, end-to-end or user-acceptance scope and cannot be mocked away as unit evidence.

grounding.quote:
Material combinatorial complexity is the claim-relative population of
independent dimensions and interactions whose combinations can change an
outcome, violate an invariant, select another authority path or expose a
failure.

concepts.label: Material combinatorial complexity

concepts.definition: User acceptance evaluates whether a declared user, with admitted capability/information, obtains the exact Product-defined outcome through the supported ordinary surface of the exact runnable subject. Basis includes current Product, requirement, UX, identity, policy and acceptance authority, user role/environment and harnessed/live mode. Its manifold covers goals, entry, permissions, inputs, configuration, dependencies/substitution boundaries, visible state/output, refusal, recovery and acceptance interval. Coordinates include Product/artifact/install, role/capability, configuration/dependency/mode, data/workspace/invocation/time/outcome/scenario identities. Evidence comprises actual requests/responses, visible projections, claimed durable effects, refusal/recovery, scenario records and exact subject/dependency identities. Its envelope requires operating as the declared user and detecting hidden setup or assistance.

grounding.quote: | evaluation family | Can a declared user, with the user's admitted capability and information, obtain the exact Product-defined outcome through the supported ordinary Product surface? |

concepts.label: User-acceptance frame

concepts.definition: End-to-end evaluation tests the exact runnable Product's complete authoritative entry-to-outcome path through every material interface, owner, state/effect, persistence, continuation, recovery and projection boundary. Basis includes composition design, supported entry, selected owners/dependencies, ordinary configuration and claim. Manifold includes causal producers/consumers, contracts, authority transitions, state/events/process, retry/replay/recovery and competing paths. Coordinates distinguish artifact/install, entry/operation, definition/owner, path/edges, process/event prefix/state/configuration/dependency/result/replay/scenario. Evidence includes invocation, semantic path/authority edges, owner receipts, durable events, state/output, claimed reconstruction, installed identity and negative paths. Capability must observe the complete path without changing it, distinguish rivals and reproduce material state/failure relations.

grounding.quote: | evaluation family | Does the exact Product subject realise the claimed outcome through the complete authoritative Product path, including every material interface, owner, state transition, effect, persistence, continuation, recovery and projection boundary? |

concepts.label: End-to-end frame

concepts.definition: Integration evaluates actual participants at one declared material composition boundary against their joint contract over result-changing state, authority, configuration, timing, failure and recovery combinations. Basis identifies exact interface/composition, actual implementations or explicitly admitted substitutes, Product/requirement/design law and interaction population. Manifold includes both sides, shared carriers, pre/postconditions, ownership, order, state, configuration, failure/retry/recovery, translation and rivals. Coordinates identify participant versions, interface/carrier revisions, state/configuration/dependency/case/input/output/failure/evidence. Evidence records actual exchanges, admitted carriers, transitions, verdicts, failures/retries/recovery, combinations and participant identities. Capability includes observing the real seam, recognising substitution and varying every material interaction dimension.

grounding.quote: | evaluation family | Do the actual participants at one declared material composition boundary satisfy their joint contract across the combinations of state, authority, configuration, timing, failure and recovery that can change the boundary result? |

concepts.label: Integration frame

concepts.definition: Unit evaluation asks whether one module-owned law holds across material operator, calculation, state/transition, public/private boundary and failure combinations. Basis is one exact module boundary, accepted ontology/design, active carrier inventory, owned requirements/public contracts, implementation and module-bounded decidable oracle. Subjects include contracts, algebras, calculations, parsers, reducers, state machines, transition functions, combinators, admission predicates, conservation/invariant laws, numerical boundaries and failures. Coordinates bind module/implementation revision, law, operator/function family, state/input/boundary, expected relation, generated case, mutation and result. Evidence includes law-derived examples, equivalence classes, available finite exhaustive cases, generative/property cases, metamorphic relations, independent calculation/algebra oracles, boundary cases and killed internal mutations.

grounding.quote:
| evaluation family | Does one module-owned law hold across its material combinations of algebraic operator, calculation regime, state, transition, public or private boundary class, and failure case? |
| subject and basis | one exact module boundary, the accepted ontology and design, the active carrier inventory the design declares, module-owned requirements and public contracts, the implementation, and a module-bounded decidable oracle |

concepts.label: Unit frame

concepts.definition: Testing value concerns material combinations discriminated for an exact claim. Its index considers at least subject congruence, dimension number/materiality, covered interaction strength, path exactness, oracle independence/precision, realistic fault/rival/historical-failure sensitivity, observability/reconstruction/reproducibility, and explicit residual combinations/invalidators. Unit value normally rises with internal combinatorial complexity and precise cheap local oracles. At broader boundaries value can be multiplicative through actual interactions, not merely many interfaces touched on one sunny path. Common Product factors are role/capability, operation/composition, selected definition/owner/implementation/dependency, lifecycle/persisted state, configuration/version, process/continuation/retry/re-entry/recovery, success/refusal/malformed/partial-failure/rival cases, fresh-process/replay/reconstruction/migration, and visible outcome/projection.

grounding.quote:
Testing value is indexed first by the material combinations a frame can
discriminate for its exact claim, not by test, assertion, file, line,
branch, mock, snapshot or runner count (P2, P6; provenance
#combinatorial-coverage-and-testing-value-index). For one claim, the
testing-value index considers at least:

concepts.label: Combinatorial testing value

concepts.definition: Technical-debt erasure examines two finite, subject-relative graphs: production closure of the exact runnable Product/configuration with transitive imports/exports, packages, switches, registries, fallbacks, consumers, generated artifacts, recovery and fresh-process reconstruction; and assurance/source closure of relied-on consumers, fixtures, proof scripts, generators, mutations and assurance tooling. Success of a successor does not prove removal of its predecessor.

grounding.quote:
A successor passing does not prove the predecessor removed. Technical-debt
erasure evaluates two distinct, finite, subject-relative graphs (P3, P6):

concepts.label: Legitimate-path and technical-debt erasure

concepts.definition: Testing evidence composition permits one execution to provide several separately bound results: user-outcome evidence, complete-path evidence, selected-seam evidence or module-law counterexamples. Default responsibilities remain user acceptance for supported-user outcomes, end-to-end for complete runnable authoritative paths, integration for participant composition, and unit for module laws with proportionate evidence.

grounding.quote:
One execution may provide several bound results. A supported user scenario
may supply user-acceptance evidence for the outcome, end-to-end evidence for
the runnable causal path, integration evidence for selected seams and unit
counterexamples for a module-owned algebra. Those claims stay distinct and
combine only through the declared relations

concepts.label: Testing evidence composition

concepts.definition: Assurance-subject acquisition and evaluation are distinct: owner-issued Product/runtime/lifecycle/admission/replay/projection truth is acquired through the exact runnable owner surface, validator, projection, receipt or reconstruction relation, then evaluated using an independently derived Product/requirement/accepted-design oracle.

grounding.quote:
Acquiring the assurance subject and evaluating it are distinct relations
(P6, P1; provenance #assurance-subject-acquisition-and-evaluation). Where a
claim depends on owner-issued Product, runtime, lifecycle, admission,
replay or projection truth, the testing frame acquires that truth through
the exact runnable owner surface, validator, projection, receipt or
reconstruction relation.

concepts.label: Owner-issued assurance subject

concepts.definition: Counterexample localisation returns the earliest supported causal frontier: causally minimal violated owner relations or seam coordinates under the declared causal relation, not earliest log/clock order. Exactly one domain form travels with its core value: unique violated locus or established incomparable joint set maps to satisfied; unresolved alternative frontiers or inability to support a bounded frontier maps to indeterminate, with alternatives or needed evidence named. The predicate is that evidence establishes the counterexample's earliest violated loci on the declared path.

grounding.quote:
One unique violated locus and a jointly established set
map to `satisfied`. Unresolved alternative frontiers map to
`indeterminate`, naming the alternatives that further evidence must
decide between. The fourth form is the core value `indeterminate` itself,
naming the evidence a bounded frontier needs. The form travels with the
value as the domain outcome, so a joint set stays distinct from a unique
locus and unresolved alternatives stay distinct from an unbounded

concepts.label: Counterexample causal frontier

conditions: Selected by the governing frame configuration or admitted work authority.
concepts.definition: urn:stdo:reference-frame:end-to-end-interface-integration:v1 is a composite refinement in urn:stdo:bounded-context:reference-frame-evaluation, owned there by REFERENCE_FRAME under the exact selected basis, with assurance law here. It relates public boundaries, design, operators, owners and proof to integration, end-to-end and user-acceptance frames, adding no fifth type, role or universal gate. It evaluates one outcome's constructability, understandability and correct realisation across a material interface chain with sufficient participant context and conserved meaning, authority and cause. Basis binds independent oracle, requirements/design, exact source/workspace checkpoint, contracts, finite cases and declared design participants or actual runnable participants/paths. Manifold includes producers, consumers, transformations, effect owners and each seam's functional/value/reference/lifecycle/time/context/mutable-subject/refusal/observation/user-result coordinates.

grounding.quote:
`urn:stdo:reference-frame:end-to-end-interface-integration:v1` is a
composite refinement whose identity resolves in
`urn:stdo:bounded-context:reference-frame-evaluation` (owned by
REFERENCE_FRAME) under the exact selected basis; its assurance law is
stated here. It relates the evaluation of public boundaries, design,
operators, owners and proof to the integration, end-to-end and
user-acceptance frames of §7. Like the set, it is available and is
activated only where the governing frame configuration or admitted work
authority selects it. It adds no fifth testing type, role or
universal activation gate

concepts.label: End-to-end interface integration

concepts.definition: Four distinct claims are contract sufficiency, whether each participant can determine/perform responsibility from declared interface and available context; boundary congruence, whether actual selected producers/transformations/consumers preserve domains, meaning, lifecycle and authority; path realisation, whether the exact runnable subject uses the authoritative path through state/effect/observation boundaries; and user usability, whether an ordinary human, LLM or software caller obtains the outcome using only declared context/access/supported surfaces. Source-grounded design may establish contract sufficiency without runtime while retaining unresolved realisability/context questions; actual-composition claims acquire both sides and exchanges.

grounding.quote: | user usability | Can the ordinary human, LLM or software caller obtain the selected outcome using only its declared context, access and supported surface? Internal success or validator-aware fixtures cannot establish this claim. |

concepts.label: Four interface claim boundaries

conditions: For each material seam in selected interface evaluation.
concepts.definition: The interface working record reuses existing truth surfaces and adds only missing cross-interface relations. Six obligations concern functional handoff/candidate stages, available actor contracts/context, lawful domain/temporal translation, current mutable-workspace observations, actual callable/effect-owner paths, and supported diagnostic causes. Schemas, prompts, adapters, indexes and tests gain no contract ownership.

grounding.quote:
Existing truth surfaces are reused. The working record adds only missing
cross-interface relations; schemas, prompts, adapters, indexes and tests do
not become another contract owner (P6, P2; provenance
#interface-integration-obligations). For each material seam:

concepts.label: Material interface obligations

conditions: Material computational composition or recurrence work.
concepts.definition: Computational whole-path evaluation composes selected interface claims with operators, owners, reused foundations and proof for one complete producer-to-consumer path under DESIGN_MODULE computational realisation/recurrence law. It binds fact establishment, every consumer, validity/invalidators, effects, retained alternatives and accumulated work, and evaluates equivalent computation across domain names without assuming semantic equivalence.

grounding.quote:
The evaluation binds fact
establishment, each consumer, validity and invalidation, effects, retained
alternatives and accumulated work. It evaluates equivalent computation
across different domain names without assuming semantic equivalence.

concepts.label: Computational whole-path evaluation

concepts.definition: Interface qualification supplies representative source-contract discriminators, not executed trials, a universal quota or whole-Product qualification. Every selected case binds its exact subject, oracle, evidence and claim scope.

grounding.quote:
These are representative source-contract discriminators: not an executed
trial, a universal test quota or whole-Product qualification. Each selected
case binds its own exact subject, oracle, evidence and claim scope

concepts.label: Representative interface qualification

grounding.quote:
The actor corrects its account within its grant; where
resolving the disagreement needs an operation, a territory or a decision
outside the grant, the step stops with `re_entry_requested(authority)`,
naming the owner of what it needs

constraints.statement: Acquisition observes the current subject and authoritative inputs. Material disagreement with cached beliefs, summaries or prior results must be reconciled by current evidence correcting the account; undecidable matters remain explicit unknowns. Stored belief, summary or prior success never overrules contrary current evidence. Prior results require applicability and invalidator checks against current subject/inputs. Correction stays within the grant; a needed operation, territory or decision outside it causes a stop with re_entry_requested(authority), naming the needed owner.

grounding.quote:
an effect
of uncertain completion keeps the value `completion_unknown`, or its end
stays not established beside its `not_effected` value, until evidence
about the subject decides it

The recovery contract that applies, which is
the resuming step's intake with the work state, determines which
observations and which effect reconciliations the next dependent action
needs. Handoff between actors is by closed results, which carry no private
working context and keep their validity and independence conditions

constraints.statement: Discarding private context resets neither workspace, valid work nor obligations. Missing context/memory/summary traces establish neither undone work nor absent or ended external effects. Uncertain effect completion remains completion_unknown, or its end remains not established beside not_effected, until subject evidence decides. Interrupted partial writes are current state assessed as they stand; unperformed assessments have no result and are never recorded as performed. No universal reset or complete-history replay is imposed. Resuming intake plus work state determines observations and effect reconciliation required before dependent action. Handoffs use closed results with preserved validity/independence. Safe context disposal requires recording the step-produced facts needed by the outer contract.
constraints.uncertainty: The full effect algebra and recovery contract are referenced but not supplied.

grounding.quote:
Rival authority,
uncertainty over failure classification and evidence uncertainty count only
where they leave materially distinct admissible semantic, authority,
outcome or acceptance interpretations; they measure or evidence the same
interpretation space removed and are not independent proportional
benefits.

constraints.statement: Each constraint identifies the semantic ambiguity it removes and contracts enough admissible interpretation space to justify added complexity. Rival authority, failure classification and evidence uncertainty count only through materially different semantic/authority/outcome/acceptance interpretations, not as independent benefits. Divergent implementation paths, runtime states, tests, reviews and joins are counterfactual evidence of contracted alternatives, not a separate numerator. A bounded detailed symbolic model is proportional when it resolves material alternatives within capacity; a prior design surface removing none is disproportionate. Duplicated truth, added joins or expanded reasoning surfaces without material ambiguity reduction are disproportionate. Existing obligations should absorb detail where ownership/meaning remain intact. Increased capability enlarges resolvable bounded relations but grants no authority, weakens no invariant and waives no acceptance.

grounding.quote:
Cost is selected, not universal. Where a cost claim is the governed
question, the activation declares its allowance and reports its spend,
measured under the selected execution binding or recorded as unmeasured
(new; P0 with UP-014's selection rule).

constraints.statement: Repeated acquisition, context assembly, hashing, preparation, status, review and evidence generation serve an identified change, decision or assurance need; repetition supplies neither validity nor independence and reuse remains subject to exact applicability/invalidation. Material operational assumptions affecting supported outcomes are qualified under UP-019. Where cost is governed, the activation declares allowance and reports measured spend under the selected binding or explicitly unmeasured spend. Separate material startup, framework processing, external computation, transport and assurance costs; declare supported input dimensions/workloads before qualification. Report volume is not model traffic: transferred-context claims count every delegated actor. Context size is measured/fitted under §2 step 3. No universal resource quota, ticket/actor count or accounting carrier follows. Delivery priority weighs likelihood, impact, reversibility, dependencies and delayed feedback, with the smallest supported product path first as SPEC_METHOD §8's default; probability waives no hard stop.
constraints.uncertainty: The referenced qualification, context-fitting and delivery procedures are not supplied.

grounding.quote:
A declared limit states its unit and the boundary over which it is
  measured: which inputs, actors, processes and repeated reads it counts.
  No universal quota, budget or measurement gate follows.
- Measurement. A declared limit is measured in its unit over its boundary
  where the obligation it serves needs the measurement; consumption
  outside the boundary is recorded as not measured

constraints.statement: A limit applies only when declared by intake, actor capability envelope or selected execution binding, through a selected frame and owning scope. Declare unit and measurement boundary including counted inputs, actors, processes and repeated reads. Measure where the served obligation needs measurement; record out-of-boundary consumption as unmeasured and exclude it from fit claims. Context limits bound simultaneous active material including later acquisitions: report starting bytes, cumulative acquired bytes including rereads, and simultaneous holding bound separately. Report measures answering different questions separately. The selected binding sets values and measurable units/boundaries; build-tenant binding is SPEC_METHOD §11. State values before the limited activation. No universal quota, budget or measurement gate follows.

conditions: Pressure on a declared resource limit.

grounding.quote:
- Exhaustion. Pressure on a declared limit never licenses omitting or
  truncating a material obligation or input. Before a limit would be
  exceeded, the activation refines the task, sequences activations,
  reassigns the work to an actor whose limits fit, or stops with the
  applicable value of §3, naming the limit, such as `incomplete` where
  bounded execution ends first; a stop keeps the unresolved outcome
  ([§1 Transitions](#transitions), Stops). Enlarging a limit re-enters the
  owner of the grant or binding that set it.

constraints.statement: Never omit or truncate material obligations/inputs because of pressure. Before exceeding a limit, refine, sequence activations, reassign to an actor whose limits fit, or stop with the applicable §3 value and name the limit; incomplete is an example when bounded execution ends first. Stops retain unresolved outcomes. Enlarging a limit re-enters its grant/binding owner. Staying within limits establishes no adequacy, and larger limits grant no authority or invariant waiver. Undeclared, unmeasured or exceeded limits cannot be read as fitting.
constraints.uncertainty: The complete §3 stop-value domain is outside the supplied source.

exceptions: Role, conversation or resumption changes that alter no bound basis coordinate, material input or required actor condition invalidate nothing.

grounding.quote:
Invalidation withdraws the result from direct reliance; whether
its evidence is retained on the new basis is decided by `retain_applicable`
of FOUNDATIONS §4 Change impact and evidence reuse, and the changed
coordinate alone establishes neither that the claim fails nor that it
holds.

constraints.statement: An unchanged consumer checks exact applicability before reuse. Dependencies meeting a change's impact cover make a result affected. Three invalidator kinds are material subject/input change, including admissible evidence capable of changing the result value; change of any bound basis coordinate; and occurrence of an observation explicitly declared to revise the result/judgment. Changed source/task/actor conditions are changed basis where bound, otherwise material input change; role changes altering required actor conditions count. Invalidate affected results before reliance even if subject bytes are unchanged, preserving predecessor/successor relation and demonstrably independent surviving results. Invalidation withdraws direct reliance but establishes neither truth nor falsity; retaining evidence on a new basis is a separate retain_applicable decision. Domain-specific triggers must be instances of these kinds, not parallel lists. Frame revision-coordinate necessity belongs to REFERENCE_FRAME §10; touched-result validity belongs here.
constraints.uncertainty: D*(t), I(Δ), retain_applicable and the full basis definition are externally owned.

exceptions: Valid mechanical evidence may be shared under EVALUATION §3's declared independence conditions.

grounding.quote:
A reused judgment does not
satisfy a separately required independent judgment; the independent assessor
acquires its own evidence and supplies its own judgment.

constraints.statement: A reused judgment cannot discharge a separately required independent judgment. The independent assessor acquires its own evidence and supplies its own judgment; mechanical-evidence sharing remains conditional on the separately owned independence law.
constraints.uncertainty: The supplied source does not enumerate those independence conditions.

exceptions: Affected risk can require whole-candidate proof before the otherwise declared candidate boundary.

grounding.quote:
Construction uses the cheapest focused proof capable of falsifying the
active relation. Expensive whole-candidate qualification occurs at a
declared candidate boundary rather than after every local edit, unless the
affected risk makes whole-candidate proof necessary (§6). A durable or
reconstructable authority claim is not established solely by a same-process
proof when loss of incidental process state is a material counterexample:
the proof destroys or excludes the incidental authority and compares the
reconstructed semantic outcomes (P5, P6).

constraints.statement: Use the cheapest focused proof capable of falsifying the active relation. Whole-candidate qualification occurs at declared candidate boundaries rather than every local edit unless affected risk requires it. Where incidental process-state loss is a material counterexample, same-process proof alone cannot establish durable/reconstructable authority: destroy or exclude incidental authority and compare reconstructed semantic outcomes. The read model itself supplies no specification, design or admission authority.

exceptions: Baseline incomplete/indeterminate pairing and the returning-party disposition assignment have pending proposed replacements.
ODD 11.8 remains specialised profile law rather than being generalised.

grounding.quote: The common single result algebra requirement, item 3, requires that distinction and accepts no particular replacement;
superseded, proposed and pending the product owner's acceptance

constraints.statement: The register claims full UP-020 conservation across relation/intake/unit/delegation, disposition, work-state continuity and transition evidence, while marking generic work state, uncertain-effect reconciliation and non-idempotence new. Workspace/account, foundation tables, transitions, configuration, effects, acquisition/measurement, stale-surface law, refinement licensing/approximation, selected allowance and generic resource limits are marked new. UP-018 reconstruction is consumed at intake; probabilistic boundary objects/commitments remain FOUNDATIONS-owned. RF engagement is conserved; AC-010/011 and RF-002/003/004/014/017 retain their successor owners, with their joined context operation new and old routes provenance only. RF-012/AC-007 core algebra/tightenings and conjunction remain FOUNDATIONS-owned; step mapping and admission-outcome mapping are refinements. Proposed incomplete→falsified applies specifically to 'a candidate is available', distinguishing unperformed evaluation from undeciding evidence; the common algebra requirement accepts no particular replacement. re_entry_requested is split by cause into two singly mapped values; totality/exclusivity and activation-refusal exclusion are claimed conserved. Disposition and ambiguity core values are new; hard stops remain §4-owned. ODD graph functions generalise to typed refinement, but ODD 11.8 and its cumulative carried environment remain profile-specific. UP-017, UP-021 and all ten standing-qualification forms are claimed conserved. UP-014/005/019 retain proportionality/cost ownership routes. Return A Closed Result is conserved with three invalidator kinds and a new domain-instance rule; ticket continuity stays TICKETS-owned. RF #engagement is classified inapplicable solely as a heading without claim text; applicability's core result, exclusion-as-no-result and disjunctive predicate are new. SM worker internals remain unprescribed; six intake items and four disposition conditions are claimed conserved. Constructor/assessor/decision-owner are allocated responsibilities, not a role inventory; no coordinating activation is required, Executive no-mutation stays profile law, and proxy limits remain FOUNDATIONS-owned. Returning-party supersession is only proposed: owner disposes, assessor recommends. Transition wording distinguishes those roles. Tier-1 progress replaces Product with selected outcome and adds mapped finer progress categories.
constraints.uncertainty: Conservation and successor mappings are source assertions; missing predecessor/successor bodies and pending owner decisions prevent independent resolution.

grounding.quote:
The failure alone
does not show whether the realisation, the governing claim, the
scenario's expected outcome or its observation is wrong;
[§12 Counterexample localisation](#12-counterexample-localisation) locates
the cause as far as the evidence supports

constraints.statement: Words in requirements/design alone do not verify operational capability. While no capability scenario can be written, operational meaning is unverified; this does not distinguish inadequate governing claim from missing means to state/observe expected outcome, so diagnosis locates the cause. Scenario failure establishes disagreement of actual and expected behaviour, not which of realisation, claim, expectation or observation is wrong; localisation is evidence-bounded. Scenarios primarily validate capability and concretely operational behaviour, do not replace requirement categories, and constraints, governance or verification-infrastructure requirements may need different evidence additionally or instead.

conditions: The respective row's instance premises hold.

grounding.quote: before closure each phase is answered, declared not applicable with a reason, or recorded as a named gap.

constraints.statement: The table labels as this member's domain/policy choices: three verification layers and product-owner scenarios; two proof authorities, bounded context and terminology; sandbox lane and harnessed/live modes; three portability forms; scenario bundles and five usual paths; fresh-sandbox preference at should; four frames and declarations; proportionate safe path mutation; eight testing-value terms and nine Product factors; four localisation forms; interface frame identity, twelve elements, four claims, six obligations and ten qualification cases; two module evidence chains, completeness/traceability sources; and nine lifecycle items. Selecting frames belongs to governing configuration/admitted work authority; scalar scores require Product/requirement/accepted-design authority. SPEC_METHOD owns chain, re-entry and lifecycle markers; ACTIVATION owns diagnosis; TICKETS owns admitted test-case derivation; FOUNDATIONS owns lineage; DESIGN_MODULE binds profile objects and computational law; EXECUTIVE_BASELINE maps roles/families. For design-governed boundaries, implementation/unit tests derive from accepted ontology, design and module boundary; evidence does not select semantic answers. Module-owned unit tests are authoritative for module proof, should trace ownership rather than helper shape, and a module without that lane is not closure-ready. Before closure every designed-surface lifecycle phase is answered, reasonedly inapplicable or a named gap; gaps proceed only when governed, and implementation proves only within its authority. Consumers apply rules without deciding more than owning sections; no consumer listing itself adds authority.
constraints.uncertainty: The referenced two chains, completeness details, traceability sources and nine lifecycle items are not enumerated in the supplied sections.

grounding.quote:
Every executable proof surface declares its authority source (P6). For
ticketed work the immediate proof authority is the admitted ticket and its
triage path: tests derive from the ticket's lawful re-entry point
(SPEC_METHOD §4) and from the governing constitutional or realisation-law
surfaces it cites; they never derive expected results from current
implementation behaviour

constraints.statement: Every executable proof declares authority. Ticketed tests derive from admitted ticket/triage, lawful re-entry and cited constitutional or realisation law, never current implementation behaviour. Conformance derives from governing design, ownership, declared carrier inventory or equivalent, structural diagrams where present and boundary fail-closed law; unit tests are conformance, and integration/negative/fail-closed tests may be when their target is a designed boundary. UAT derives from requirements, acceptance criteria, scenarios/use cases and Product release/qualification claims. Execution breadth/speed/determinism does not determine authority. Local filenames/runner labels must map every executable lane to this taxonomy before closure.

exceptions: An explicitly equivalent isolated composed-product proof lane may be called UAT or acceptance.

grounding.quote:
Under this method only sandbox tests, or an explicitly equivalent isolated
composed-product proof lane, may be called UAT or acceptance tests.

constraints.statement: UAT exercises deployed, installed or otherwise runnable composed Product through declared application/public/runtime/control surfaces using requirement-sourced scenarios/acceptance cases. Source unit/helper/module-integration checks cannot alone close user acceptance and are not UAT. Harnessed sandbox uses deterministic/fake/recorded/injected worker or result surfaces and proves exercised composition, orchestration, control, projection, archive and scenario wiring reproducibly. Live sandbox crosses real configured worker/tool/agent/service or probabilistic transport and returns evidence through declared result/evaluation/provenance/projection surfaces. Where Product/release claims depend on live probabilistic compute, semantic, unit, module-integration and harnessed greens are necessary but insufficient for live acceptance. A projection labelled live is not live UAT unless it crosses the real boundary.

grounding.quote:
A missing external fixture fails with a governed diagnostic that names the
fixture authority and the lane; it never masquerades as a product semantic
failure
a missing fixture means the evaluation was not performed, so it is reported as such, never as a product semantic failure.

constraints.statement: Required closure lanes must reproduce from the declared source boundary; unit/semantic/module-design lanes cannot depend on undeclared local paths, sibling workspaces, operator homes or mutable external fixtures. External project evidence requires one of: checked-in minimal fixture; manifest naming external source/version/acquisition or binding rule; or classification as harnessed sandbox, live sandbox, reference comparison or optional local evidence rather than required semantic closure. A missing fixture yields a governed diagnostic naming fixture authority and lane, reporting evaluation not performed, never Product semantic failure.

grounding.quote:
No live requirement is fully proved on
informal operator confidence, ambient habit or an unlabelled test corpus

constraints.statement: Every live requirement requires written traceable test-case authority including expected-result assertion provenance. Informal confidence, habit, unlabelled test corpora and green labels cannot establish full proof or acceptance. Derivation from admitted work authority remains TICKETS §7's rule.

conditions: A requirement claims meaningful system behaviour.

grounding.quote:
Features are not proved by isolated assertions alone. Where a requirement
claims meaningful system behaviour, the proving surface should be a scenario
bundle or an equivalent ordered set of test cases that exercises that
behaviour through a coherent sequence rather than as disconnected
fragments

constraints.statement: Isolated assertions alone do not prove features. The proving surface should use a scenario bundle or equivalent ordered test cases through coherent use; this is a recommendation, not an unconditional requirement for the named bundle format.

conditions: The system has an installable or runnable development form.

grounding.quote:
That
proof should prefer a fresh sandbox or equivalent isolated environment, an
installed or built development artifact, and execution through the same
declared entry, control and runtime surfaces the real product uses. Direct
source-level or unit-level checks may stay useful; they do not replace
installed-dev proof

constraints.statement: The decisive lane runs against the installed development version as an external target, not merely the source tree. It should prefer a fresh sandbox/equivalent isolation, installed/built development artifact and the Product's declared entry/control/runtime surfaces. Source/unit checks remain useful but do not replace installed proof.

grounding.quote:
If the significant paths are not declared, scenario coverage cannot be
judged. If they are declared and not exercised, the behaviour is not fully
proved

constraints.statement: Declare and exercise significant paths. Undeclared paths make coverage unjudgeable; declared but unexercised paths leave behaviour not fully proved. Usual path categories apply where relevant, not as a universal exhaustive branch checklist, and claim scope cannot exceed evaluated evidence.

conditions: Testing frames are selected.

grounding.quote:
The fan-out assigns claims to evidence; it is neither an authority
hierarchy nor a claim that one frame decomposes into another.

constraints.statement: The four frames add no role, stage, authority or hierarchy. Their topology assigns user-outcome, runnable-path, composition-boundary and module-law claims to congruent evidence, not decomposition. Bound results reach Product/release disposition only through declared relations, including conjunction, translation, falsification and re-entry. Broader frames cannot make narrower laws true, and any number of narrower greens cannot establish unevaluated Product/user claims. Labels without corresponding frame declarations have no assurance value. Each core result remains recorded with its claim predicate. Frame invalidation rows here and in §13 name instances of material input change or changed basis, adding no invalidator kind.
constraints.uncertainty: The referenced general result, translation and conjunction laws are not fully supplied.

exceptions: Admitted harnessed sandbox substitution supports only actually exercised composed relations.

grounding.quote: | authority | bounded evaluation only; the frame mints no Product meaning or acceptance authority, and an automated actor does not become the human or Product acceptance owner |

constraints.statement: Apply Product/requirement outcomes, supported-interface, identity, UX, safety, persistence/release law, RF-001–017 and named EVALUATION proof-target, separation, congruence, freeze/revision, comparison and qualification laws. Evaluation creates no Product meaning or acceptance authority. Exclude source imports, private APIs, state injection, test-only endpoints, hidden admin capability, undeclared fixtures/substitutes, doubles at claimed-real/live boundaries, compatibility bypasses and internal success substituted for user outcome. Return one exact user-claim core result with witnessed paths, counterexamples, residual user populations and invalidators. Material changes to Product/interface/role/capability/configuration/dependency/substitution mode/data contract/runnable subject/acceptance meaning/ordinary path invalidate affected results. This is the primary outcome frame when the claim concerns user use. Real external compute/transport claims require live sandbox UAT; substituted unit/integration/semantic/end-to-end evidence and harnessed green are insufficient.
constraints.uncertainty: Referenced RF and EVALUATION laws are not reproduced.

grounding.quote:
The expected output is necessary and not sufficient. Reaching it through a
forbidden or obsolete path falsifies the end-to-end claim. A test is not end
to end because it starts and finishes in one process, crosses many lines or
carries an end-to-end label

constraints.statement: Apply Product/accepted-design composition, exact-subject/congruence, required path singularity, lifecycle/authority/persistence/replay/recovery/release law. Observation may expose internals but cannot bypass, repair, replace or reinterpret the path. Exclude source-only substitutes for runnable claims, invocation below supported entry, doubles at claimed-real boundaries, test routing, hidden retries/repair, omitted persistence/fresh-process boundaries and equal output without path evidence. Return one exact claim result with exercised edges, unexercised paths, counterexamples and residual combinations. Material artifact/install/dependency/configuration/interface/owner/path/lifecycle/persistence/recovery/projection/test-semantics/population changes invalidate affected results. Expected output is necessary, insufficient; forbidden/obsolete paths falsify the claim. One process, many lines or labels confer no end-to-end standing.

exceptions: Explicitly bounded substitutes may support narrower admitted claims.

grounding.quote: | authority | bounded boundary evaluation only; no integration result establishes an unevaluated Product outcome or authorises a substitute participant |

constraints.statement: Apply interface/composition law, complete participant admission, applicable atomicity/reconstruction and exact assurance boundary. Boundary results neither establish unevaluated Product outcomes nor authorise substitutes. Exclude mocks hiding the claimed real contract, one-sided assertions, happy-path-only exchanges, helper equivalence, flattened versions/states and whole-Product projection without governing relation. Return one declared integration result with covered combinations, counterexamples, omitted interactions and invalidators. Material participant/interface/carrier/state/configuration/dependency/timing/failure/recovery/population changes invalidate affected results.

grounding.quote:
Low
internal combinatorial complexity justifies a small lane, not omission and
not hundreds of implementation-shaped tests. Unit-test volume has no
independent closure value

constraints.statement: Every coded module requires its design-profile module-derived unit lane, including public module contracts as valid subjects. Bind accepted ontology/carriers/domain/sequence/state/algorithm/error relations and derive oracles independently of implementation. Return one module-law/population core result with counterexamples, residuals and invalidators; material ontology/inventory/boundary/law/algorithm/state-space/numerical-regime/implementation/oracle/generator/population changes invalidate affected results. Complexity selects proportional strategy/size and smallest congruent population, never eligibility or omission. Implementation-restating oracles/incidental-branch cases give weak/circular evidence. Composition, orchestration, configuration, persistence, ownership and user-interaction complexity needs actual-boundary broader evidence; mocking cannot convert it to unit proof. Exclude Product outcomes, cross-module composition, supported user paths, packaging/install, real externals, orchestration topology, mocked interfaces, incidental branches/helper layouts and count/coverage as broader assurance. Unit results confer no Product, installed, integration, acceptance, architecture, path-selection or release authority; no count, coverage, mutation score, duration or pass history closes those claims.

grounding.quote:
The activated frame declares the finite interaction population and why its
covering set is adequate. Pairwise or other covering-array reduction is
lawful only where the basis explains why the omitted higher-order
interactions cannot change the claim, or keeps them as residuals.
High-consequence authority, persistence, concurrency, recovery, migration
and historically failure-prone relations normally need explicit
higher-strength combinations

constraints.statement: Activated frames declare finite interaction populations and covering-set adequacy. Pairwise/covering-array reductions require a basis explaining why omitted higher-order interactions cannot change the claim, or retain them as residuals. High-consequence authority/persistence/concurrency/recovery/migration and historical failure relations normally need explicit stronger combinations. Code/source/line/branch/function coverage diagnoses visitation only, not semantic combinations, authoritative paths, user outcomes or absent rivals.

exceptions: A properly isolated and declared test-only seam outside production is not itself a production-path failure.

grounding.quote:
1. required-path reachability: each required authoritative composition has
   an exact witness in the deployed, installed or otherwise runnable
   Product form through the supported ordinary path; and
2. forbidden-path exclusion: each material superseded, duplicate,
   fallback, bypass or otherwise forbidden production path is absent,
   unreachable or refused at its declared boundary.

constraints.statement: Every Product path claim requires exact ordinary-runnable witnesses for each required composition and absence, unreachability or boundary refusal of each material forbidden/superseded/duplicate/fallback/bypass path. No obsolete/bypass/fallback/rival production path remains reachable in claimed production scope; no obsolete assurance consumer may falsely supply closure or reintroduce removed production paths. Where proportionate and safe, path-sensitive mutation checks that disabling authority prevents success; forcing rivals refuses or exposes counterexamples; corrupted interface/owner results are detected at the owning boundary; and deleting asserted obsolete paths changes no accepted outcome except through declared deletion relation. Forbidden-path outcomes falsify path claims. Negative tests that mutate the exact subject without isolation, restoration and subject revalidation invalidate their assurance basis.

grounding.quote:
Each bound result states which
predicate it establishes; a result over a necessary condition does not
establish the obligation, and the sufficiency of a conjunction is a claim
of its own

constraints.statement: Distinct results combine only through declared relations and state their predicates. A necessary-condition result does not establish its obligation, and conjunction sufficiency is a separate claim. User acceptance alone may leave internal path singularity unassessed; end-to-end success may leave unselected user populations/combinations unassessed; integration/unit cannot substitute for either. When a Product claim requires all, missing/conflicting results remain visible to the decision owner's disposition and cannot be hidden by aggregate green.

grounding.quote:
Where the acquired observation cannot
separate two admissible subjects on which the assessed predicate takes
opposite truth values, the frame returns further evidence, a justified
narrower scope or `indeterminate`.

constraints.statement: Harnesses, fixtures, expected-value builders, scripts, evaluators and assessors must not reconstruct parallel owner state from raw payloads/events/logs/filenames/labels/implementation fragments and assess it as the Product. Observation binding itself requires support. If observation cannot distinguish admissible subjects with opposite predicate truth values, obtain further evidence, justify narrower scope or return indeterminate. Missing required owner projections/observable seams remain named assurance/design gaps, never rival harness semantics. The owner-issued subject requirement does not require trusting implementation as the semantic oracle; derive that oracle from Product, requirement and accepted design.

grounding.quote:
Localisation records the subject, basis, frontier form and members, causal
evidence, expected relations, the observed counterexample and the
downstream claims it invalidates. It does not collapse a jointly
established set into one arbitrary owner, and it does not report
unresolved alternatives as a joint cause

constraints.statement: Return only the earliest frontier the causal evidence supports. An established joint set consists of incomparable earliest loci whose combined violation is necessary to the supported explanation; unresolved alternatives are not that joint cause. Preserve unique/joint/alternative/unbounded distinctions with core values and deciding evidence. Record subject, basis, form/members, causal evidence, expected relations, observed counterexample and invalidated downstream claims. Do not collapse joint sets to arbitrary owners or treat unresolved explanations as established. Counterexamples persist until disposed. Localisation grants no expanded testing, compatibility repair, new controller or reinterpretation of unchanged upstream meaning; scope/design changes follow existing SPEC_METHOD re-entry.

conditions: The composite frame is selected.

grounding.quote: | result and relations | each activated claim returns a core result with its exact evidence, coverage, causal findings and residuals; shared evidence is referenced once; mandatory claims compose only through a declared same-basis or lawful-translation conjunction (FOUNDATIONS §4 Conjunction of results) to the named decision consumer |

constraints.statement: Keep Product/artifact/install/workspace/observation/invocation/candidate/admitted-result/evidence identities distinct; bind exact revisions, domains, units, cardinality, order, empty/null/default meanings and validity intervals. Equal shape/output implies no equal meaning, provenance or authority. Apply selected Product/requirement/design/interface, declaration/translation and conjunction laws while existing owners retain semantic, operational, admission and reserved decisions. Activation grants bounded evaluation; construction needs the existing exact operation grant; named consumer disposes. Design evidence keeps unresolved realisation facts explicit; realised claims acquire actual request/context/response, callable/configuration identity, owner validation, effect/observation and ordinary caller outcome, independent expectations and substitution limits. Capability requires relevant domain/composition/lifecycle/diagnostic competence and exact-subject access without altering reviewed subjects; independence remains claim-relative. Exclude hidden context/privilege, rival contracts, inferred authority, undeclared substitutes, private/test paths for ordinary claims, candidate-as-admission, fixture-as-user evidence and unsupported whole-Product/future conclusions. Each activated claim returns its own evidence/coverage/causes/residuals; reference shared evidence once and compose mandatory claims only by declared same-basis or lawful-translation conjunction. Material contract/domain/participant/prompt/context/capability/path/configuration/translation/workspace-observation/lifecycle/oracle/population changes invalidate affected conclusions, retaining unchanged valid evidence and rulings. Mechanical checks supply no semantic/live-user qualification.

grounding.quote:
An unknown material condition keeps its dependent claim
unresolved: the claim's result is never `satisfied` and names the
condition as what would decide it

constraints.statement: Select claims by applicability and give scope reasons for every unselected claim; unselected claims have no result. Design-only work requires no unavailable runtime evidence and reports no runtime/UAT satisfaction. Actual boundary behaviour is not proved by design correspondence; path output through other routes is insufficient; internal/validator-aware fixture success does not establish ordinary usability. Unknown material conditions leave dependent results unresolved, never satisfied, with the deciding condition named. Full end-to-end usability requires all four distinct results and explicit conjunction; any unselected claim is uncovered coverage for that full claim. Transport, parse, admission, semantic satisfaction, operation completion and user success remain distinct.

conditions: For each material seam.
exceptions: An adequately declared candidate interface can lawfully produce a normal model refusal or inadmissible candidate without that fact alone falsifying its claim.

grounding.quote:
Direct successful handoff requires the producer's guarantees to meet the
   consumer's preconditions. An interface may instead emit candidates:
   candidate output, later admission and semantic assessment stay distinct
   declared stages.

constraints.statement: Bind functional input domain, producer success guarantees, consumer preconditions, permitted effects, refusals and observable exit. Direct successful handoff requires guarantees meeting preconditions; candidate output, later admission and semantic assessment may instead be distinct declared stages, evaluated against exact promises/refusal behaviour. Make material obligations/domains available through actual interface/context or an exact lawfully resolvable locator. Bind material LLM role/instructions/context/tools/model/transport configuration. Generic governance access neither replaces Product-specific contracts nor authorises hidden validator inference. Deterministic owners expose owned facts to context/validation through reuse or proven-equivalent projections; semantic actors judge within that domain without inferring reserved rulings, eligibility, authority or admission. Preserve domain/time through serialisation/parsing/normalisation/adaptation; translations bind source/target coordinates, meaning, accepted loss, provenance, owner and refusal. Distinguish proposed/admitted/assessed/completed, active/historical and valid/merely byte-available states; wire-shape equality proves no translation.

conditions: For each material seam and later operation.

grounding.quote:
Product redaction rules
   still govern sensitive content. Missing required diagnostic evidence
   stays a named gap. Return the smallest supported owner or re-entry;
   diagnosis grants no repair or retry

constraints.statement: Observe current mutable workspace for each later operation separately from immutable authority/artifacts/history/prior candidates; invalidate changed dependencies, retain unaffected accepted work, and do not repeat still-valid work solely for actor changes. Snapshots do not replace current subjects. Follow actual callable path/effect owners to selected exit and required fresh observation; hidden fallback, injection, repaired output, private entry or undeclared retry cannot prove ordinary real paths. Pure functions acquire no new event lifecycle from evaluation. Preserve supported causal frontier through wrappers/projections, including available originating seam/field/path, expected domain/basis, mismatch/evidence locator, downstream symptoms, successes and declared continuation/block. Preserve joint/alternative/indeterminate causes, apply redaction, name missing diagnostic evidence and return smallest supported owner/re-entry without repair/retry authority. Acquire owner facts through existing surfaces and independent contract-derived oracles; computed facts, contextual judgments and reserved rulings retain separate owners/validity.

grounding.quote:
For an LLM-interface usability claim, clean-room LLM UAT is used, with the
ordinary supplied context and permitted tools and without private
implementation knowledge or fixture assistance. Expected outcomes are
recorded before responses are inspected.

constraints.statement: LLM-interface usability claims use clean-room LLM UAT with ordinary supplied context/permitted tools, no private implementation knowledge or fixture assistance, and expectations recorded before responses. Include sunny and material ordinary ambiguity/negative cases. Disclose substitutions: replayed/fabricated responses prove only stated narrower relations, not live-provider usability. Do not edit responses or silently retry until green. Live claims need live evidence, but design gains no universal live-provider requirement. Early sunny threads may establish bounded evidence while unexercised claims remain open. The frame adds no exhaustive-hardening prerequisite, quota, controller, runtime, generator, routine human approval, ledger or automatic extra agent; existing authority selects proportionate assurance/operations. Return for all four claims a core result or unselected scope reason plus exact subject/path, supported mismatch, retained work, substitutions, residuals and invalidators in the existing carrier. The result is neither acceptance nor next-action grant.

conditions: Material computational composition or recurrence work.

grounding.quote:
An identifiable complete-path result and its evidence return to the
declared decision consumer; a collection of local successes cannot replace
that result. Design-only evidence establishes only the design claim; claims
about actual work need observations on the selected path.

constraints.statement: Qualification challenges declared workload/operational assumptions and preserves independent scope, freshness and effect checks serving distinct obligations. Return an identifiable complete-path result/evidence to the declared consumer; local successes do not replace it. Design-only evidence proves only design; actual-work claims need selected-path observations. Reuse valid unchanged results and reassess affected claims on material path/basis/workload change. This is bounded frame composition, not a permanent actor, new family, per-helper review or separate ledger.
constraints.uncertainty: DESIGN_MODULE's computational and recurrence law is not supplied.

conditions: A representative case is selected.

grounding.quote: | design-only sufficient contract | A bounded contract result can close while runtime and user claims stay unclaimed or unresolved according to their applicability; no runtime or UAT satisfaction is inferred. |

constraints.statement: Selected cases discriminate: usable empty and non-empty eligible domains without universal-empty workarounds or hidden required rules; legitimate candidate refusal/admission filtering versus inadequate interfaces or broken success guarantees, with model variability alone no failure; owner-defined eligibility/lifecycle versus merely available historical/same-response references; temporal/admission mismatch despite individually valid shapes; translation loss of units/default/identity/order despite validation; fixture knowledge versus ordinary usability; forbidden-path equal output as falsified path realisation; refreshed affected workspace evidence with retained unaffected valid work; supported causal frontier/uncertainty rather than symptoms or invented uniqueness; and bounded design-contract closure without inferred runtime/UAT satisfaction, leaving other claims unclaimed or unresolved by applicability.

Retains proportionality and cost law; foundation standing and linked consumer applications remain bounded reference dependencies.
Retains declaration, conditional measurement, exhaustion alternatives, owner re-entry and non-authorising standing.

Retains conditional selection, four-frame topology and non-hierarchical evidence relationships.
Retains declaration coordinates, evidence/exclusion boundaries and conditional automation/live proof.

allowed: Vary internal decomposition, search, collaboration, tools or synthesis when variation cannot affect governed semantic, authority, evidence, safety or release properties.
The owning law may justify one coherent constraint family once.
forbidden: Require rationale fields, receipts or repeated audits for every clause or consumer merely because family justification is needed.
Treat increased actor capability as authority or a waiver of invariants or acceptance.

grounding.quote:
The method does not prescribe an internal decomposition, search,
collaboration, tool or synthesis procedure when variation in that procedure
cannot affect a governed semantic, authority, evidence, safety or release
property.

allowed: Omit transfer of internal working context when the closed result and provenance suffice for the consuming decision.
Attach working context for audit or other purposes without changing the result.
Share valid mechanical evidence between independent evaluations under declared EVALUATION §3 independence conditions.
forbidden: Use a reused judgment to satisfy a separately required independent judgment.

grounding.quote:
The frame's internal working context need not be
transferred when the closed result and its provenance are sufficient for
the consuming decision; it may still be attached, for audit or otherwise,
without changing the result. Independent evaluations may share valid
mechanical evidence under the declared independence conditions

forbidden: Promote transition evidence to specification, design or admission authority.

grounding.quote:
Consumers
choose the representation. Transition evidence is a read
model; it does not become specification, design or admission authority

allowed: Frames may overlap and one execution may supply evidence to several, while each result remains bound to its own claim.
forbidden: Infer assurance value from a UAT, E2E, integration or unit label without the corresponding declaration.

grounding.quote:
The frames may overlap, and one execution may supply evidence to several of
them; every result stays bound to its own claim. A label such as `UAT`,
`E2E`, `integration` or `unit` has no assurance value without the
corresponding frame declaration

allowed: Automate user acceptance only when automation faithfully occupies the declared user's frame without any path or capability the user lacks.
forbidden: Let automation assume human or Product acceptance authority.

grounding.quote:
It may be automated only when the
automation faithfully occupies the declared user frame and gains no path or
capability that user lacks. Automation can execute acceptance evidence; it
cannot assume acceptance authority

allowed: Use substitutes or doubles for deliberately narrower claims only with explicit equivalence boundaries and exclusions.
forbidden: Promote substitute evidence to a claim that real participants or Product composition were exercised.

grounding.quote:
A substitute or test double may support a deliberately narrower claim only
when its equivalence boundary and exclusions are explicit. Its result
cannot be promoted to evidence that the real participant or Product
composition was exercised

allowed: Define a project scalar through Product, requirement or accepted-design authority, retaining underlying coverage coordinates and explicit quantified-claim model/limits.
forbidden: Require a universal scalar or flatten away coverage coordinates into a score.

grounding.quote:
No universal scalar is required. A project may define one only through
Product, requirement or accepted-design authority, and keeps the
underlying coverage coordinates rather than flattening them into a score

allowed: Retain a test-only seam if isolated from Product distribution, excluded from ordinary-path evidence and declared in the assurance subject.
forbidden: Let an obsolete test/proof consumer falsely establish the claim or reintroduce a removed path; such a consumer remains an assurance defect.

grounding.quote:
A test-only seam is lawful when it is isolated from the Product
distribution, excluded from ordinary-path evidence and declared in the
assurance subject. Its presence outside the production graph is not a
production-path failure. A retained obsolete test or proof consumer stays
an assurance defect when it can falsely establish the claim or reintroduce
the removed path

allowed: After lawful acquisition, evaluate using independently derived oracles.
Compute bytes, digests, ordering, equality, membership, completeness and conjunction over owner-issued evidence.
forbidden: Mint owner carriers, choose current history, select authoritative paths, interpret owner lifecycle/admission meaning or become a runtime fallback through generic assurance mechanics.

grounding.quote:
Generic assurance mechanics may compute bytes, digests,
ordering, equality, set membership, completeness and conjunction over
owner-issued evidence. Those mechanics stay evidence evaluators: they
cannot mint owner carriers, choose the current history, select the
authoritative path, interpret domain lifecycle or admission meaning, or
become a runtime fallback
